title: Text Word V2.5
description: A word of a Text, with the time it spans and the confidence with which it was recognised.

MInstanceID.description: Identifier of the M-Instance (Virtual Space) where this Text Word is or is intended to be located.

UEnvironmentID.description: Identifier of the U-Environment (Real Space) where this Text Word is or is intended to be located.

TextWordID.description: Unique identifier of this Text Word instance.

TextWordTime.description: Time this Text Word was produced.

TextQualifier.description: Qualifier providing information on Sub-Types, Formats and Attributes of the Text.

ConfidenceScore.description: Confidence with which the word was recognised, 0 to 1.

Word.description: The word, as one or more strings.

DataXMData.description: MPAI-PTF Data Exchange Metadata providing provenance, authorisation, legal and security information on the Data.

DescrMetadata.description: Human-readable descriptive metadata of the Text Word (plain text, max 2048 characters).
